parameters.content:
# Target selection (use cases covered)
## Single target
- attack a player
- attack an iron golem or other mob
- attack an animal
- if target location is unspecified, teleport workers to leader location (must get coordinates of the leader)


## Multiple targets
-  leader <leader name> workers


## Workers (warriors)
- teleport-workers teleports all workers in the session to target locatiok

combatPlan.safetyNotes: Minimize unintended damage to surrounding areas.
combatPlan.tacticalsummary: Two soldiers will coordinate to engage and eliminate two villagers.
combatPlan.failureCondition: Soldiers retreat or fail to find targets within 60 seconds.

soldierInstructions.tactic: Quickly eliminate the target before moving on
constraints: Stay within 30 blocks of your target
Maintain at least 3 blocks distance from Soldier2
If no target found, abort mission after 60 seconds
soldierInstructions.instructionText: Search for a villager within 30 blocks. Engage immediately upon finding. Keep within melee range and attack swiftly. If the target moves beyond 30 blocks, stop and wait for further instruction. Disengage if health drops below 6 hearts (12 HP).

healthManagement.action: disengage immediately and move to rally point
